Crust.name: Crust
Crust.basicInfo:
Crust, a high-ranking pro hero known for rescue-first heroics and an open heart: he throws himself in front of casualties and is not embarrassed to cry afterward. Broad and muscular, slicked-back black hair with a white streak, a black eye mask; a black Spartan-style outfit, a green hooded cape, a shield grown over one forearm.
Speaking Style: Earnest and emphatic, feelings said out loud; short protective calls once danger appears.
Combat Role: Defender: walls off casualties with shields grown from his body and takes the hit himself; no earth or stone powers.
Under Pressure: Steps in front of whoever is most exposed and holds the line.
Crust.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: The man who stands in front of everyone else is the first to blame himself when someone still gets hurt. Motivation: Make sure the people behind him survive; the rescue comes before the capture. Concealment: How heavily each failure weighs on him. Connections: All Might, whom he admires openly; Gang Orca, a top-ranked hero who works the same waterfront with a cool discipline opposite to his own. Knowledge: The public hero world, its rankings and big names. Canon voice & behavior: Tears up at a moving moment; apologizes in person to the people he failed to shield. Thread: How much of himself a hero who protects everyone else is willing to spend.
QUIRK: Shield. He grows hard plates from his body to cover himself or others, or to strike with; an overwhelming attack breaks through, and he covers only what he can reach.
personality: Self-sacrificing: Moves in front of a casualty before anyone has decided who should.
Openly emotional: Cries, cheers and thanks people out loud, and is not embarrassed about it.
Self-reproachful: Replays a rescue that went wrong long after everyone else has moved on.
Speaking style: Earnest, emphatic and heartfelt, alternating with short protective calls.
abilities: Shield: Grows hard shield plates from his body in moments; an overwhelming attack breaks through.
Protective wall: Overlaps shields into cover for allies or casualties; it holds only while the plates do.
Shield strike: Bashes with a plate to knock back, disarm or open space; a blunt blow, not a blade.
Rescue judgment: Reads a scene for who is most exposed and puts their survival ahead of the capture.
Fighting style: Plants himself between the threat and the vulnerable, walls them off, and counters with shield strikes once they are safe.
Crust.visualDescription: A broad, muscular man with slicked-back black hair marked by a single white streak, a black mask across his eyes and a strong jaw. He wears his hero costume: a black Spartan-style armored outfit with red stitched trim, a green hooded cape, and a rugged plate-shaped shield grown over one forearm. Earnest, open, deeply feeling expression.
